attributes.additional_details: We believe the British public should have the opportunity to vote on the future direction of the country. We are concerned about issues including illegal immigration, border security, public services and the cost of living, and believe these should be decided by the electorate through a General Election.
attributes.background: We believe the British public should have the opportunity to vote on the future direction of the country and this is needed now more than ever.

rejection.details: We already have a petition calling for a general election now.
